components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The intentional action for analysis, export, and confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 38px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; padding: 0 15px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--blue, #1769e0); color: #fff; font: 650 13px ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(15,88,199,.18); transition: background 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-strong, #0f58c7); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(23,105,224,.28); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A compact bordered action for reversible or lower-priority choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 38px; border: 1px solid #ccd4df; border-radius: 7px; padding: 0 15px; background: #fff; color: var(--slate, #172033); font: 650 13px ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f5f7fa; border-color: #aeb9c8; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(23,105,224,.28); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #edf1f5; }

components.name: Search Field
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"></path></svg><input placeholder="Search members" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search { width: 290px; height: 38px; border: 1px solid #cfd7e2; border-radius: 7px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--muted, #667085); background: #fff; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--blue, #1769e0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(23,105,224,.12); } .ds-search svg { width: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-search input { border: 0; outline: 0; min-width: 0; width: 100%; color: var(--slate, #172033); font: 13px ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Member Navigation Row
components.description: A dense member row combining identity, location, and explicit review state.
components.css: .ds-member-row { width: 320px; min-height: 55px; padding: 7px 13px 7px 17px; background: var(--blue-soft, #eaf3ff); border: 0; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--blue, #1769e0); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9px minmax(0,1fr) 24px; gap: 9px; align-items: center; text-align: left; color: var(--slate, #172033); cursor: pointer; } .ds-member-row:hover { background: #e1efff; } .ds-member-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(23,105,224,.28); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--amber, #d58400); } .ds-member-copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; } .ds-member-copy strong { font: 700 13px ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-member-copy small { color: var(--muted, #667085); font: 11px ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--amber, #d58400); background: var(--amber-soft, #fff7df); font: 800 11px ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; }

components.name: Unresolved Status
components.description: An explicit amber badge for values still requiring professional review.
components.html: Unresolved
components.css: .ds-status-unresolved { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--amber, #d58400); background: var(--amber-soft, #fff7df); font: 700 11px ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-status-unresolved svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; }

components.name: Confirmed Status
components.description: A green icon-and-label badge for established reviewed values.
components.css: .ds-status-confirmed { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--green, #168548); background: var(--green-soft, #eaf7ef); font: 700 11px ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-status-confirmed svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.5; }

components.name: Evidence Notice
components.description: A floating contextual notice linking the current sheet to occurrence and cited pages.
components.html: Showing page 4. Exact highlight unavailable in the second-pass data.
components.css: .ds-evidence-notice { max-width: 640px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.96); border: 1px solid #cfd6df; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(24,35,53,.12); border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 10px; display: flex; gap: 7px; align-items: center; color: #475467; font: 11px ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-notice svg { width: 15px; flex: 0 0 auto; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-evidence-notice button { border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--border, #d8dee8); background: transparent; color: var(--blue, #1769e0); font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; padding-left: 9px; } .ds-evidence-notice button:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-evidence-notice button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(23,105,224,.28); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
This is a cool white and slate operating environment for professional drawing review. It feels precise, quiet, and trustworthy: evidence occupies the dominant canvas while navigation and decisions stay compact and immediately adjacent. The interface behaves like a disciplined review instrument rather than a conversational dashboard.

Blue is deliberately scarce and signals selection, navigation, and intentional action. Amber identifies unresolved work, green confirms established values, and labels or icons always reinforce those meanings. The visual system documents only the review experience driven by `second_pass_result.json`; first-pass data is not a UI source or visual dependency.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence-dominant desktop composition with a narrow member navigator and contextual lower review tray.
Crisp one-pixel separators, cool tonal layers, and compact controls instead of decorative panels.
Restrained semantic color reinforced by text, icons, and state-specific shapes.
Dense, scannable sans-serif typography with tabular numerals for quantities and dimensions.

rules.name: The Semantic Reserve Rule
rules.body: Blue means action or selection, amber means unresolved, green means confirmed, and red means failure; do not use these colors as decoration.

rules.name: The Never Color Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state color is paired with a label, icon, shape, or positional treatment.

rules.name: The Drawing Leads Rule
rules.body: Typography must remain compact enough that interface chrome never competes with the source sheet.

rules.name: The Numeric Clarity Rule
rules.body: Counts, zoom values, and member dimensions use tabular numerals wherever alignment aids scanning.

rules.name: The Evidence Ownership Rule
rules.body: The PDF canvas receives all flexible space; navigation remains narrow and review controls remain contextual below the canvas.

rules.name: The Two-Zone Rule
rules.body: Do not turn the workspace into a permanent three-pane chat layout. Conversation and direct editing belong in the same contextual review tray.

rules.name: The Flat Until Floating Rule
rules.body: If a surface participates in the workspace grid, separate it with a border or tonal shift; use shadow only when it physically overlays another layer.

rules.name: The Crisp Frame Rule
rules.body: Keep working surfaces rectangular and aligned; larger radii belong to isolated setup or modal moments, not the evidence workspace.

dos: Do keep the drawing canvas dominant and preserve the 320px navigator / flexible evidence split.
Do use one-pixel separators and cool tonal layers for ordinary workspace structure.
Do pair unresolved, confirmed, changed, skipped, and error colors with explicit text or icons.
Do keep missing dimensions explicit as absent values; never visually imply that null equals zero.
Do describe and render the review UI from `second_pass_result.json` only.
donts: Don't add a permanent chat column or reduce the drawing to a secondary preview.
Don't decorate the interface with semantic blue, amber, green, or red.
Don't use large cards, generous consumer-app spacing, or rounded containers throughout the operational workspace.
Don't estimate exact dimensions from the rendered drawing or suggest pixel measurement as evidence.
Don't expose, blend, or visually depend on first-pass extraction data.
